metadata.description: Three mods for a Claude Code session that hands work to subagents: a lane cap and model ladder, a write fence for read-only agents, and a test verdict that names its writer.

plugins.name: lane-pace
plugins.description: A live-lane cap, a model ladder, and a brief check on every subagent spawn

plugins.name: lane-fence
plugins.description: A read-only agent's Bash writes refused outside its own record paths

plugins.name: lane-blame
plugins.description: Who wrote the red: the test verdict attributed to the agent that wrote the file

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Anthropic's playground mod: holds rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, a force push, and a migration, and shows what each would change, with Proceed and Cancel

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Anthropic's playground mod: a live forecast of the context window, drawn above the prompt
